steps.title: RRST (breathing resistance)
steps.instructions: In the Physio Recorder fill in Participant and Session, pick RRST, click 1 Check signals and wait for green; ask for one or two test breaths through the mouthpiece and check that the Flow trace shows them. Then press Start here: RRST opens in MATLAB and asks three questions; type the values below and press Enter after each. Recording starts by itself and stops a few seconds after RRST finishes. Press Done when the Last recording panel shows PASS.
prompts: RRST device and SensorBridge plugged in
Flow sensor arrow points toward the participant
Physio Recorder: RRST picked, signals green, test breaths seen in Flow
